critical_code_review_comments: AnalyticsGrowthPage.jsx — trendOf() at L26-30 returns null when prev === 0 (falsy check `if (!prev) return null`). This means when prev=0 but curr>0, no trend is shown — but rule-based text says 'fără istoric comparabil' which is correct semantically. However this also masks the case where prev=0 and curr=0 (should probably show 0% not null). Minor.

AIInsightCard's `onAction` at L134 no-ops silently when `insights.recommendations` is empty. Consider disabling the 'Vezi recomandări →' button (or hiding it) when the list is empty to give the user better feedback — currently the click appears to do nothing.

analytics_growth.py L446-462 — kpi_prev computes previous period via `days_len = (d_to - d_from).days + 1` then subtracts one day for p_to and days_len for p_from. Correct math but 6 sequential count_documents calls could be batched with a single aggregation for performance if data grows.

DSBadge at L259 uses `type='ACTIVE'` but displays the channel name ('whatsapp') as its label. This is intentional (type controls color, children controls text) but the test-plan phrase 'appears in list with ACTIVE badge' can be confusing — consider adding a separate 'ACTIVE' status pill next to the channel badge for clarity.

Positive: All required data-testids are present and unique. TabBar/ActionBar/KpiCard/AIInsightCard/DataTable/EmptyState components from /app/frontend/src/design-system/index.jsx render consistently. Design System reference implementation is production-ready.
